name: 1-methyl-4-phenylpiperidine-4-carbonitrile
summary: Pethidine intermediate A is a four-phenylpiperidine derivative that is a precursor to the opioid analgesic drug pethidine (meperidine). It is not known to have any analgesic activity in its own right, however other derivatives of pethidine with a 4-cyano group in place of the carboxylate ethyl ester have been found to be active, so pethidine intermediate A might also show opioid effects.

pharmacology.text: It is not known to have any analgesic activity in its own right, however other derivatives of pethidine with a 4-cyano group in place of the carboxylate ethyl ester have been found to be active, so pethidine intermediate A might also show opioid effects.

uses.en: It is a chemical step in making pethidine and has no medical use of its own. Because of this it is a controlled substance in many countries.
uses.zh: 它是製造配西汀的化學中間體，本身沒有醫療用途。因此在許多國家被列為管制物質。
uses.zhHans: 它是制造配西汀的化学中间体，本身没有医疗用途。因此在许多国家被列为管制物质。

fact.en: Pethidine, the drug it is used to make, was first made in Germany in the late 1930s by chemist Otto Eisleb, who hoped for a drug to relax muscles. Its painkilling power was found afterwards by Otto Schaumann.
fact.zh: 以它為原料製成的配西汀（pethidine），最早由德國化學家Otto Eisleb在1930年代末合成，原本希望做出肌肉鬆弛藥。它的止痛效果是後來由Otto Schaumann發現的。
fact.zhHans: 以它为原料制成的配西汀（pethidine），最早由德国化学家Otto Eisleb在1930年代末合成，原本希望做出肌肉松弛药。它的止痛效果是后来由Otto Schaumann发现的。
